observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment pytest, compileall, Git integrity checks, and vertical proof

verified_behaviors: Exact owner and service execution identity joins scheduler results to scheduled execution rows before persistence.

The bounded history retains result classification, result content identity, source-reference status, reuse state, and explicit not-established verification status without retaining the source pointer.
A trace without a result section, a result section without an exact row, and a legacy history row without new fields remain distinct observations.

The existing projection exposes latest and retained result fields while latest_trace_relation remains latest-only; compact output preserves result classification and verification labels under the tested response budgets.
The existing vertical proof resolves and enters the environment, invokes a provider, enforces a protected write boundary, checkpoints, resumes, and hands off a session.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Owner-result evidence is lost when the scheduler trace is replaced
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment incremental owner-pass results, retained execution history, and capability-intelligence projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: Regression tests demonstrate exact retention and projection of scheduler result status while preserving the distinction between result content integrity and service verification.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Observe the same relationships after ordinary persisted owner activity; do not force an expensive owner pass solely to populate favorable evidence.

measurement_limits: Test fixtures establish the behavior of the exact correlation path but do not establish a live retained-result match in the selected session.
A recorded scheduler result and its content digest are not independent verification of service correctness or fulfillment.
The vertical proof validates the session workflow and protected write boundary, not production service-need detection.
